page: Google Cloud Platform m4-megamem-112 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the m4 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 112 dedicated vCPUs alongside 1488.0 GB of RAM. This configuration delivers a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 13.29 GB per vCPU, positioning it for memory-bound enterprise workloads.

This instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated graphics processing units, meaning all storage requirements must be met using network-attached block storage. It also features zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that the 112 vCPUs deliver consistent compute performance without resource contention from other tenants.

Given the massive memory footprint relative to the vCPU count, the m4-megamem-112 represents a specialized hardware profile where cost efficiency is optimized for large-scale in-memory processing rather than general-purpose compute. It is highly suited for workloads such as large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data analytics pipelines, and other memory-bound enterprise applications.
